newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco seeks investors for gold mine.
newsitem.headline: Morocco seeks investors for gold mine.

text.p: Morocco on Tuesday launched a public tender for investment in a gold ore mine in the southern province of Ouarzazate, an official at the state-owned Bureau de Recherche et Participation Miniere (BRPM) said.
The closing date for the tender was set for February 14, 1997, the bureau said.
"Through this tender, BRPM aims at attracting investors who are interested in developing the Tafrant gold mine," the official said.
A technical visit to the mine, located in the southern area of the Atlas mountains, will be organised by the bureau on November 11, he added.
The private ONA group, which recently purchased four mines including a silver mine, told Reuters it had no plans at present to subscribe to the tender.
ONA bought the four mines -- producing silver, fluorite, cobalt and copper -- in August for 648.8 million dirhams.
